question: Show the title and season of the episode with production code 'CYB001'.
gold_sql: SELECT title, season FROM episodes WHERE production_code = 'CYB001'

question: Show the titles of episodes in season 1 with topic 'Navigation'.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes WHERE season = 1 AND topic = 'Navigation'

question: Show the title and season of episodes that teach fractions.
gold_sql: SELECT title,season FROM episodes WHERE lower(topic) LIKE '%fractions%'

question: List the distinct season numbers in descending order.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT season FROM episodes ORDER BY season DESC

question: How many Cyberchase episodes are there?
Show each season and how many episodes it has.
gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season

question: Which season has the most episodes? Show the season and count, including ties.
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS n FROM episodes GROUP BY season) SELECT season,n FROM counts WHERE n=(SELECT MAX(n) FROM counts)

question: Show the name of school with id 1 and the name of its district.
gold_sql: SELECT schools.name, districts.name FROM schools JOIN districts ON schools.district_id=districts.id WHERE schools.id=1

question: Show the school name, district name, and per-pupil expenditure for school with id 1.
gold_sql: SELECT schools.name,districts.name,expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM schools JOIN districts ON schools.district_id=districts.id JOIN expenditures ON districts.id=expenditures.district_id WHERE schools.id=1

question: Which players earned the highest salary in 2001? Show first name, last name, and salary, including ties.
gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE salaries.year=2001 AND salaries.salary=(SELECT MAX(salary) FROM salaries WHERE year=2001)

question: Which seasons have more than 10 episodes? Show the season and count.
gold_sql: SELECT season,COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(*)>10

question: Show district names that have at least one school with a graduation rate over 95.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT districts.name FROM districts WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schools JOIN graduation_rates ON graduation_rates.school_id=schools.id WHERE schools.district_id=districts.id AND graduation_rates.graduated>95)

question: Set the topic to 'Fractions' for the episode with id 1.
gold_sql: UPDATE episodes SET topic='Fractions' WHERE id=1
